desc: Read input N, X, Y, S, T.
Check if the number of '1's in S equals the number of '1's in T. If not, print "No" and exit.
Compute the prefix sums for S and T using the weight function: '0' maps to Y, '1' maps to -X.
Verify that for every index i from 1 to N, $P_i(S) \equiv P_i(T) \pmod{X+Y}$.
If all prefix sums match modulo $X+Y$, print "Yes"; otherwise, print "No".
